items.claim: Keep ISR path overrides out of untrusted serverless requests. A non-ISR `_render` request for `/api/public?x_astro_path=/api/private` with `x-vercel-isr: 1` and no middleware secret renders the private route; the same request without that header renders the public route.
items.consequence: This reopens unauthenticated path selection in ordinary serverless handlers and can defeat upstream path restrictions if that header is forwarded.
items.proposed_fix: Restrict this fallback to a trusted ISR invocation context, preserve secret-gated overrides on `_render`, and cover the header-bearing request in the security test.

items.claim: Does Vercel prevent external ISR headers from reaching ordinary functions?
items.consequence: The answer determines whether the confirmed handler boundary regression also permits an external bypass of path-based restrictions, and therefore its deployment reach and urgency.
items.proposed_fix: A Vercel maintainer can supply the authoritative ingress contract, or a controlled deployment can compare externally supplied ISR headers at a non-ISR handler. This settles the external exposure of `vercel/unauthenticated-isr-path-override`.
